pattern: ^\(node\) ExperimentalWarning: stripTypeScriptTypes is an experimental feature
reason: Unfold calls module.stripTypeScriptTypes on purpose (scripts/check.mjs, src/runtime/kubernetes.ts). Node 24 still labels it experimental. Remove this entry when the Node line Unfold pins marks it stable.

pattern: ^\[WARN\] Tarball download average speed \d+ KiB/s \(size \d+ KiB\) is below \d+ KiB/s:
reason: pnpm's fetchMinSpeedKiBps notice measures the runner's network to the npm registry, not the repository. On small tarballs it is dominated by request latency. The install still succeeds, and a download that actually fails stops setup on its own.
